description: LocalRouter on one AMD Strix Halo box (Ryzen AI Max+ 395, Radeon 8060S gfx1151, unified memory with a 96 GiB GTT pool): Qwen3.8 Flash-Next chat through Gufo (ROCm, Q4 + MTP) or llama.cpp (Vulkan, Q3 + MTP) as openai_server tools, Qwen3-TTS and Qwen3-ASR through Gufo behind the generic openai_audio cmd worker, and Whisper large-v3-turbo on PyTorch ROCm. Model servers run in rootless Podman (tools/gufo/serve.sh); the daemon runs as a transient systemd user unit (deploy/strix-halo). The compiled-in CUDA engines (Qwen-Image, MiniMax H3, Kandinsky-6) and Drama 3 have no AMD build and are not part of this profile.
tested_on: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S (gfx1151), 128 GB LPDDR5X with amdgpu.gttsize=98304 (96 GiB GTT), kernel 7.2, ROCm 7.2.4, Podman 6.1 (runc), 2026-11-15: chat over /v1 on both chat tools, speech and transcription over /v1/audio, the voice loop over /v1/realtime (tools/spark/jarvis/voice_e2e.py --smoke)

prereqs.title: jq, curl, git, tar, xz, sha256sum, python3, podman, systemd-run
prereqs.test: for t in jq curl git tar xz sha256sum python3 podman systemctl systemd-run; do command -v $t > /dev/null || exit 1; done
prereqs.fix: install them with the distribution's package manager (Arch/Omarchy: sudo pacman -S jq curl git tar xz python podman)

prereqs.title: /usr/bin/python3 3.11 or newer (the openai_audio worker and the scripts)
an AMD GPU on amdgpu with ROCm (rocminfo lists a gfx1151 agent)
prereqs.fix: install ROCm 7.2 or newer (rocminfo, the HIP runtime); add yourself to the video and render groups and log in again

prereqs.title: /dev/kfd and /dev/dri/renderD* usable by this user
prereqs.fix: sudo usermod -aG video,render $(id -un), then log in again

prereqs.title: a GTT pool of 90 GiB or more (amdgpu.gttsize / ttm.pages_limit on the kernel command line)
prereqs.fix: a host setting this installer never changes: see the Gufo host configuration guide (amdgpu.gttsize=98304 ttm.pages_limit=25165824) and reboot

prereqs.title: rootless Podman that can run a container
prereqs.fix: install podman (and crun or runc); check: podman run --rm docker.io/library/alpine true

prereqs.title: a systemd user session (the daemon runs as a transient user unit)
prereqs.fix: log in through ssh or a desktop session (not su)

prereqs.title: HTTPS to huggingface.co, github.com, ghcr.io and ziglang.org
prereqs.test: for u in https://huggingface.co https://github.com https://ziglang.org; do curl -fsS -m 15 -o /dev/null -I $u || exit 1; done; curl -sS -m 15 -o /dev/null https://ghcr.io/v2/
prereqs.fix: open outbound HTTPS to those hosts (and download.pytorch.org, pypi.org)
